what is pubg mobile and when was it launched and when was it's golden era in simple language explain

PUBG Mobile is a free battle‑royale (many‑player last‑person‑standing) game for smartphones where up to 100 players land on an island and fight to be the sole survivor. It launched worldwide on 19 March 2018 (after a China‑only beta earlier that year), and its golden era—when player counts, revenue, and esports viewership peaked—was roughly 2019‑2020.
